bootstrap: Throughline is a local, authoritative coordination state layer for domain-neutral work. It records intent, plans, work, outputs, validation, reuse, and delegated authority; it does not orchestrate agents or perform external effects. Capability does not imply Authority. Call get_semantic_model for details.

entities.name: Objective
entities.definition: A durable goal that groups work items.

entities.name: Plan
entities.definition: A versioned proposal for achieving an objective; approval commits work without executing it.

entities.name: WorkItem
entities.definition: A proposed, executable, reviewable, or trackable unit of domain-neutral work.

entities.name: ContextRecord
entities.definition: Typed authoritative context such as a requirement, constraint, assumption, finding, risk, or success metric.

entities.name: AcceptanceCriterion
entities.definition: An individually stateful condition used to judge completion.

entities.name: OutputProfile
entities.definition: An immutable, versioned, governed definition of an output class.

entities.name: ExpectedOutput
entities.definition: A work-item-specific contract bound to one exact output profile version.

entities.name: OutputRevision
entities.definition: An immutable produced candidate bound to an expected output and profile version.

entities.name: ValidationRecord
entities.definition: An append-only verdict and evidence record for one output revision.

entities.name: OutputRequirement
entities.definition: A dependency on an accepted output revision or compatible profile.

entities.name: Dependency
entities.definition: A directed, typed relationship between work items.

entities.name: Decision
entities.definition: A concise durable choice with rationale and scope.

entities.name: Question
entities.definition: An unresolved question that may request human attention or block work.

entities.name: Approval
entities.definition: A durable request and decision for a governed target.

entities.name: Artifact
entities.definition: A typed external reference, not a large database blob.

entities.name: Claim
entities.definition: A time-limited lease that an actor is working a work item.

entities.name: Activity
entities.definition: An append-only audit event for a material state change or action.

entities.name: Actor
entities.definition: A trusted-local human, agent, or service identity.

entities.name: Capability
entities.definition: A vendor-neutral ability required or offered by an actor.

entities.name: ExternalAction
entities.definition: A versioned proposal for an observable side effect outside Throughline.

entities.name: AuthorizationSubject
entities.definition: The canonical authorization-relevant subset of an external action revision.

entities.name: AuthorityGrant
entities.definition: A principal-bound grant for one exact authorization subject within constraints and lifetime.

invariants.statement: A work item cannot depend on itself; hard prerequisite cycles are rejected.
At most one unexpired active claim exists per work item; claims are reclaimable leases.
Mutations use expected_version and reject mismatches without overwriting current state.
Expected outputs are satisfied only by accepted immutable revisions with passed or waived validations.
Capability does not imply Authority; external effects require a matching principal-bound grant.
Throughline never executes an ExternalAction; external actors record execution and evidence.
Authorization uses the same canonical subject serialization and hash for proposal, grant, check, and audit.
Active output profile versions and produced output revisions are immutable; changes create new versions.
